en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?

Ah, honestly...being trapped in here, and
on top of that, forgetting my talent...
I'm not exactly in the mood to study.

Oh? That doesn't seem
like you, Shuichi...

Everybody has a side to them that
they don't show to others.

Discovering those private things about each
other is part of the fun of relationships.

You're right, it is pretty dusty!
Why don't we clean it up a bit?

Hey, maybe I'll even remember what
my <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltNORMAL> is while we're cleaning!

...I don't really think my talent is cleaning,
though. Maybe just wishful thinking.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Rantaro looks deep in thought...
